notes.title: Saving Fix #3
notes.notes:
Okay hopefully this is the final time I have to fix the save/load system.

-Inventory save/load sets the correct mode
-Endings now only bring you back to the hub, and the main menu doesn't wipe progress anymore (not sure why it was like that originally tbh)
-fixed some other minor UI stuff

notes.title: Saving Fixes 2
notes.notes: [p]So I ended up making both saving/loading work on the main menu, just need to swap over with the middle mouse button. Also fixed an issue with the YOU FAILED text in the endings covering up buttons. There may (probably) be some jank with it, but it's 4 am and I'm sneezing constantly. Let me know in the discussions if I screwed something up.[/p][p][/p][p]Have fun! ː6faceː[/p][p][/p][p]-T[/p]

notes.title: (Mostly) fixed saving
notes.notes: Separated out our loading and fixed some issues with loading items into your inventory, so hopefully you won't spawn out of bounds, missing all your gear and with amnesia. It's still kinda weird with you having to input a name every time you launch the game and then you load a save, but that's less a glitch and more having like 2 hours left before submission.
